# Equipment icons

Thirteen original SVG icons authored for BONK Arena: iron_blade, long_spear,
iron_armor, light_armor, swift_boots, war_boots, ember_axe, nature_aura,
wisdom_aura, frost_aura, saiyan_aura, void_aura, and celestial_aura.

Each icon uses a 64 × 64 viewBox, transparent background, with geometric silhouettes. Aura icons also use curved paths and rings. The icons are local assets and require no external host.

Visual direction: the inventory screenshot supplied by the user at
/home/odoo/new_game/images.jfif (dark inset cells and small colored equipment).
The screenshot itself is not distributed with the application.

The user suggested https://www.svgrepo.com/collection/game-assets/ and that
collection was reviewed. These files are NOT downloads from SVG Repo.
Direct download from this environment failed due to DNS resolution, so original
project-owned SVGs were created instead. No third-party artwork is embedded.

Named variants share these base shapes via the catalog asset field. Tier labels and borders distinguish rarity.

Each aura has its own icon, used in inventory and above its loot chest. The
matching animated character effects are drawn in Canvas by drawAura in game.js.
The Saiyan icon is original golden energy artwork, not a downloaded character
sprite. Effect colors are independent of the catalog rarity colors.
